    annualised_capex

    annualised_capex.Rd

    Equivalent annualised cost of a home heating system.

    annualised_capex(
  tech,
  kW,
  installation_time,
  installation_type,
  house_type,
  construction_year,
  params,
  grant_type,
  oss_heat_draw = NULL,
  existing = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    tech

    heating technology

    kW

    system capacity

    installation_time

    time of installation - different from params$yeartime

    installation_type

    "new" or "swap"

    house_type

    seai house type

    construction_year

    year, integer

    params

    time of interest or current time

    grant_type

    grant type

    oss_heat_draw

    NULL if random 0,1

    existing

    TRUE or FALSE - whether we are evaluating an existing system or a potential new system -default FALSE (new system)

    Value

    euro amount

    Details

    The discount rate set from calibration (params$r.). A present bias params$beta. (above a threshold) is assumed. The value returned by annualised_capex() depends on whether the system is new or for an existing system installed at installation_time. A new system is selected by setting existing to FALSE. In this case annualised_capex() returns $$crf_{weibull} \times capex$$ where \(crf_{Weibull}\) is the capital reduction factor for a system with Weibull survival function. On the other hand, for an existing system (finite age) annualised_capex returns $$(crf_{weibull}- r erv_{weibull})\times capex$$ erv_weibull() returns the The difference between these quantities \(r erv_{weibull}\) can be interpreted as a penalty for retiring a heating system before it has failed.

    Examples

    sapply(2010:2040, function(y) annualised_capex("heat_pump",18,2010,"swap","detached",2003,scenario_params(sD,y),"WarmerHomes", existing=FALSE))
#>  [1] 2082.265 2086.165 2090.066 2093.966 2097.867 2101.767 2107.618 2115.419
#>  [9] 2123.220 2131.021 2138.822 2146.623 2154.424 2162.225 2170.027 2177.828
#> [17] 2181.728 2181.728 2181.728 2181.728 2181.728 2181.728 2181.728 2181.728
#> [25] 2181.728 2181.728 2181.728 2181.728 2181.728 2181.728 2181.728
params <- scenario_params(sD,2026)
replicate(100,annualised_capex("heat_pump",13,params$yeartime,"new","detached",2003,params,"None",oss_heat_draw=NULL)) %>% table()
#> .
#> 2394.10672768941 
#>              100 
params$beta. <- 0.5
annualised_capex("heat_pump",8,params$yeartime,"new","detached",2003,params,"OSS",0)
#> [1] 555.4281
annualised_capex("heat_pump",8,params$yeartime,"new","detached",2003,params,"BetterEnergyHomes",0,existing=TRUE)
#> [1] 293.1096
